title: Net negative posts sink to the bottom
dek: For each reader, a post the model expects them to dislike ranks under every positive post.
whatChanged: The offset_score function adds 0.001 to a positive combined score. A negative combined score is scaled into a small range using the same NEGATIVE_SCORES_OFFSET constant, which is 0.001 in the value model weights. So for that reader, a net negative post ranks under every post that came out positive. These are defaults in the public repo, and live settings can differ.
meaningForCreators: Once a post turns net negative for a reader, raw like counts stop helping it with that reader. A post a reader is predicted to dislike sits at the bottom for them, however many likes it gets elsewhere.
action: Do this: check your recent posts for anything that might make readers hit mute, block, or not interested, and fix the ones that do.
